free_parameters.identification_labels_note: The identification labels on offer_curve_by_group and offer_curve_smoothing are CARRIED FORWARD VERBATIM from the predecessor keeper's committed ledger (2026-09-07-spp-3-screened-input / spp43_screened_B), where they read 'measured-physical'. build_dof_ledger.py's builder default labels the same two entries 'residual'. SAME NAMES, SAME VALUES, and this run changes NEITHER: every SPP offer band is the identity 1.0 on all registered classes and no band, share or smoothing value moved. Leaving the builder default would assert that this run introduced two residual-identified free parameters when it introduced none. The builder-vs-committed discrepancy itself is NOT resolved here and remains SPP-50 R-3 (FINDING-spp-50-2026-09-08.md section 8), an open item for the SPP desk.

governance.authorized_price_tuning_declared: NONE. No offer_curve_by_group band -- or any other value -- in this run was set by looking at a price residual. Every band SPP carries is the identity 1.0 on all registered classes (rule 25 [R-ISO-SCOPE]); rule 1's carve-out is not invoked and there is nothing to declare under it. The run_config diff against the predecessor keeper is exactly ONE field: vre_curtailment_oversupply_allocation False -> True.
governance.attested_by: SPP-51c (2026-09-09), promoted on the owner's in-session ruling, verbatim: 'Is this a recommended keeper candidate? If so plz promote. If structural integrity improves but gates regress that may still be a keeper.' THE RUN: keeper-3's recipe plus exactly one gated field, vre_curtailment_oversupply_allocation, solved as ONE --year 2023 2024 2025 invocation, years sequential (rules 12/16). WHAT THE FIELD DOES: it re-allocates the HOURS of SPP's measured annual wind curtailment and changes no annual total. SPP's renewable bound was delivered_EIA930(t)/(1-0.096501), a FLAT per-hour gross-up verified flat to 99.94/99.93/99.98 % of hours; delivered is already NET of curtailment, so the measured 9.65 % was spread uniformly over all 8,760 hours -- everywhere except where it happened -- and the LP re-curtailed 0.0003-0.0017 %. The field water-fills the SAME frozen annual energy onto the lowest-net-load hours, capped by the fleet's own online capacity, at the level lambda that makes the annual identity hold. ZERO NEW FREE PARAMETERS (rule 21 [R-DOF]): lambda is not chosen but is the unique root of that identity and is reported, never set; the cap is measured EIA-860 capacity; load and delivered output are series the LP already consumes. The DOF ledger is therefore UNCHANGED from keeper-3 at 3 entries / 1 residual. Rule 23 [R-FROZEN-DERIVE]: the SPP-32 measured reference rate is untouched and the annual wind potential is identical to the flat rule's in every year (114.0552/120.9925/122.2552 TWh). Rule 13 [R-MEASURED]: forward-native on every leg. Rule 19 [R-ONE-MECH]: it REPLACES the flat gross-up at the one seam that builds the bound and never stacks on it. Rule 25: ISO-agnostic, no per-ISO number, default off, so all six other keepers replay byte-identical and keep their cache keys. ALSO IN THIS RUN'S SCORED BASIS, and it is an INPUT REPAIR, not a model change: the committed SPP actual-LMP sidecar was indexed on SPP's GMT market interval while the model's 8760 calendar is fixed Central Standard Time, so C3a's hour-matched rt_lw was scoring against a series six hours out of phase. Repaired by a pure re-indexing (sorted value set identical, equal-hour annual mean unchanged to four decimals); the direction and the constant +6 were fixed by physical markers and by SPP's own GMT-stamped GenMix load, never by a residual. Rule 14 [R-ACCURATE]. Rule 22: 2023-2025 only; SPP holds no holdout marker and none is spent.

disclosures.gates_that_still_fail: C3c FAILS in all three years (model 0/4/2 hours >$200 against 42/59/68 actual) -- SPP has no scarcity mechanism of any kind and that is SPP-55's object, not this run's. C3a-2025 FAILS at +10.28 % against a +-10 % band, and C3b-2025 at 0.2043 against <=0.20; both are marginal misses and both IMPROVE against the control.
disclosures.the_mechanism_is_necessary_not_sufficien: Reported at full magnitude: this field does NOT close the object it targets. It creates SPP's negative-price regime for the first time (229/214/159 system load-weighted hours below $0 against a control of essentially zero, pricing at exactly -$26.00 where wind is marginal) but reaches only ~15-23 % of the ~1,000-1,170 measured negative hours, and it FAILED the pre-registered structural screen gate on 2025 (G-1a 177 interior-wind hours against a predicted 871, band 348-2178; G-1b 159 against a predicted 592, band 237-1480; G-3 the wind identity moved only 1.10681 -> 1.10489). The screen's own root-cause measurement: the LP absorbs 98.2 % of the concentrated headroom by displacing thermal rather than spilling wind -- in the 2,848 allocated 2025 hours where wind did not go interior, thermal still had 8,200 MW of turn-down available, and the model's thermal ANNUAL MINIMUM is 254.3 MW across a ~40 GW fleet because SPP carries zero commitment floors and zero bridges. The binding limb is the thermal-commitment floor (SPP-51b R-2), and rule 19 [R-ONE-MECH] requires any successor floor to be RECONCILED with this allocation, never stacked on it.
disclosures.promoted_over_a_failed_screen_gate: This run was promoted by an explicit owner ruling AFTER the session recommended against promotion on the failed structural gate. The gate result is not withdrawn, not re-cut and not re-scored; it stands as recorded in FINDING-spp-51c-2026-09-09.md section 3.
